description: Part time commercial use of existing swimming pool for childrens swimming lessons
decision_conditions: The use of the existing swimming pool outbuilding for part-time commercial use hereby permitted shall be for a limited period only for eighteen months from the date of this decision notice after which time the commercial use shall cease and the building only be used only for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling house and not for any trade or business.
Reason: To enable the Local Planning Authority to retain an appropriate level of control over the use sought..
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the following approved plans:
M98240/2 Revision A
Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved and is compliant with development plan policy.

The commercial use of the swimming pool shall not commence until works to the highway to enable the full width of the frontage to be used for parking are carried out. Throughout the period when the commercial use is operating, the area to the front of the property shall be kept for the parking of 4 vehicles.
Reason: To ensure construction of a satisfactory access and in the interests of highway safety, good design, traffic movement and amenity in accordance with Policy 24 of the Havering Local Plan.
During the commercial use of the swimming pool, external doors and windows should remain closed, save for the entrance/egress of customers/staff.
Reason: In order to protect the amenity of residential properties.

The commercial use of the swimming pool shall be limited to accommodate a maximum of two children per class and two staff at any given time. Only one class in the building shall run at any point in time and there shall be a minimum of 15 minute gap between end of one class and the beginning of the following class.
Reason: To restrict the use of the premises to one compatible with the surrounding area and that the development accords with Policy 7 of the Havering Local Plan 2016-2031.
The proposal shall not be used for the purposes hereby permitted other than during school term time and only between the following hours
Monday - Tuesday 1600h to 1930h
Wednesday 0930h to 1115h and 1600h to 1930h
Thursday 1600h to 1930h
Friday 0930h to 1130h
Saturday 0900h to 1315h
Sunday between 0900h to 1145h
Reason: To enable the Local Planning Authority to retain control in the interests of amenity.
[U]Positive and Proactive Statement[]

The Local Planning Authority has acted positively and proactively in determining this application by assessing the proposal against all material planning considerations, including planning policies and any representations which were received.  It subsequently determined to grant planning permission in accordance with the National Planning Policy requirement that applications for sustainable development are approved where possible.  A detailed analysis of the scheme is set out in the report on the application prepared by officers.
[U]Highways Matters[]

You are reminded that this decision notice only addresses requirements under Planning Legislation.  It does not give consent for an permanent or temporary changes to the public highway, the use of the public highway for the storage of materials or placing of apparatus associated with the construction or other processes, nor does it permit the discharge of surface water onto the public highway.  You are encouraged to check whether or not works or activities necessitate separate consents under the requirements of other, non-planning legislation at the earliest opportunity by emailing environmentbusinesssupport@havering.gov.uk for further information.  Unauthorised work on or use of the public highway and a failure to prevent the discharge of surface water on to the public highway area all an offence.
